_comment: Pixel-wise MLE, drawn by emtk. The Qt tool's AutoForm spec is pixel_mle.view.json.

sections.title: Settings
sections.description: The photon files and the IRF, the channels and fit window, the fit model and its parameters, the IRF preparation, the background, the performance settings and Run.

buttons.label: Run
buttons.description: Fit every selected file pixel-by-pixel; writes <stem>_pixel_mle.csv next to each.

sections.description: Fit every selected file pixel by pixel in the background.
What was fitted: files, pixels fitted and the median lifetime per file; errors of a run.

sections.title: CLSM imaging files
sections.description: Confocal (CLSM) TTTR image file(s) to analyse. Drag-drop to add.

sections.title: IRF file
sections.description: IRF TTTR measurement (the first file is used).

options.add_tip: Choose the IRF measurement (the first file is used).

sections.label: Parallel channels (∥)
sections.description: Space-separated routing channels forming the parallel (VV) detection.

sections.label: Perpendicular channels (⊥)
sections.description: Space-separated routing channels forming the perpendicular (VH) detection.

sections.description: Fit-window start on the binned micro-time axis.

sections.description: Fit-window stop on the binned micro-time axis.

sections.label: Micro-time binning
sections.description: Integer down-binning of the micro-time axis before fitting.

sections.label: Min photons
sections.description: Pixels with fewer photons in the fit window are not fitted.

sections.label: Region
sections.description: Optional region confining the fit to part of the frame — regions saved in CLSM Draw (.json), a Cellpose segmentation (_seg.npy), a label image or a binary mask. Leave empty to fit the whole frame.
Pick the region file.

buttons.label: Browse region
buttons.description: Browse for a region file: regions saved in CLSM Draw (.json), a Cellpose segmentation (_seg.npy), a label image or a binary mask.

sections.label: Fit model
sections.description: Per-pixel fit2x estimator. fit23 = one lifetime + anisotropy; fit24 = bi-exponential; fit25 = pick the best of four fixed lifetimes. The tau map is x[0] for every model.

sections.label: Engine
sections.description: Histogram extraction: fast = vectorised C++, loop = exact bincount, auto = fast with bincount fallback on saturation.

sections.label: Threads
sections.description: Fit worker threads. 0 = auto (cpu − 1); 1 = serial.
